name: Raise the Bar
tagline: Fri bar 17–21 — planlæg hvad I skal smage
splashBody: Ridehuset, Aarhus · fredag 9. oktober 2026. Rate øl undervejs og lås holdet op.

beers.name: Sherry Oloroso Lambik S25/26 Blend no. 28

description.text: Hazy double IPA dry-hopped with Citra, Citra BBC, Ekuanot and Topaz, giving a hop-forward profile with lots of fruit character in the aftertaste.
Hop-aromatic, fruity NE IPA with clear bitterness and slight sweetness; notes of pineapple, pine, passion fruit, sponge cake and grapefruit.
Soft, juicy NEIPA on pilsner, pale ale and chit malt with oats, dry hopped with Citra, Galaxy and Nelson Sauvin for citrus, ripe tropical fruit and white grape.
Hazy NE IPA with a soft, dense, silky body from wheat and oats, dry hopped with Strata, Galaxy and Citra for passion fruit, mango, pineapple and lime-grapefruit zest.
Bad Seed's first hazy triple IPA, triple dry hopped with Citra, Strata and Nelson Sauvin. Velvety, full body that isn't too sweet, with dank Nelson, pineapple, passionfruit, mandarin and peach.
The brewery's flagship North German-style pilsner: fresh, dry and bitter, with fresh-cut grass and citrus hop notes over a delicate malt base. Hopped with Hallertau Mittelfrüh and Tettnang.
Foeder-fermented mixed-culture Berliner weisse loaded with strawberry, blueberry, raspberry and Madagascar vanilla, like a berry jam sour.
Hazy IPA with Amarillo, Azacca and Citra: grapefruit and sweet orange aroma, juicy tropical flavour, dry finish and a soft, pillowy body.
French-style pilsner with French malt, a bit of corn and Strisselspalt hops: grassy, biscuity and bready, with lemon pith, wildflower and spruce notes.

beers.name: I Think It Might Be Broken

description.text: Double dry-hopped hazy IPA with Nelson Sauvin, Citra and Mosaic on a soft, supple grist built to carry juicy hop character.
Farmhouse beer fermented and aged in French Chardonnay barriques with a blend of wild yeast strains.
Built on Burning Sky's Monolith, aged in a Chianti foudre with wild yeasts for chocolatey, vinous oak flavours and mild acidity.
Pilsner malt with noble German hops, fermented cold, then dry-hopped and lagered for an extended period.
Cryo Fresh edition of Ebeltoft's Wildflower NEIPA, built on pilsner malt, rye and wheat, here with Mosaic. Wildflower has pineapple and lime notes, a near full body and is very drinkable.
Cryo Fresh edition of Ebeltoft's Wildflower NEIPA, built on pilsner malt, rye and wheat, here with Simcoe. Wildflower has pineapple and lime notes, a near full body and is very drinkable.

beers.name: The Great Northern Barrel Aged Series 57

description.text: Bourbon-barrel-aged barleywine blended with aged old ale. Toffee and brown sugar with black cherry, fig and raisin, plus whiskey, wood char and vanilla.

beers.name: The Great Northern Barrel Aged Series 58

description.text: Rich malty barleywine aged 43 months in new charred American oak. Woody vanilla and barrel char over date, caramel and toffee, with a nutty, mellowed finish.

beers.name: Even More Daily Servings Mixed Berry
The Great Northern Barrel Aged Series 55

description.text: Blend of whiskey- and maple-syrup-barrel-aged stouts conditioned on macadamia nuts and vanilla. Massive chocolate, whiskey caramel, maple and nuttiness with creamy vanilla.

beers.name: Red Wedding (2024)
beers.style: BA Imperial Stout w. coffee and lactose

beers.name: Où Chante une Rivière
beers.style: French Whisky BA Imperial Pastry Stout

beers.name: Brume des Îles
beers.style: Pastry Sour w. passion fruit, mango and coconut milk

description.text: Golden, crisp German-style pilsner with clean malt, a hint of bready sweetness and gentle, moderate bitterness.
Strong fruited sour with peach and guava for soft tropical sweetness and mandarin for bright citrus. Described as bold and full-bodied.
Malty Märzen lager with soft bread, biscuit and gentle caramel notes, clean bitterness and herbal, floral Hersbrucker hops. Smooth and drinkable.
Juicy, lush hazy IPA hopped with Citra and Motueka, soft and tropical with a strong hop flavour.
Soft, hazy NEIPA with Waimea, Riwaka, Nectaron and Nelson Sauvin: citrus, lime and passionfruit, ripe peach and nectarine, and a white-wine grape edge.
Traditional English best bitter with biscuit, toasted bread and caramel malt, plus earthy, gently spicy East Kent Goldings. Balanced and crushable.
Slightly hazy deep-amber Helles with dried apricot, fresh peach, bread and wheat notes, a crisp bitterness and a dry, long finish.
Hazy DDH IPA dry hopped with Citra, Riwaka and Nectaron, brewed with barley, wheat and oats.
Munich-style festival Helles with sweet malt, fresh bread, caramel, dried apricot and raisin notes; oily, balanced bitterness and very quaffable.
Brett IPA blended from two aged beers, dry hopped with Vic Secret and Citra and spiked with peach and passionfruit; crisp with peach sorbet, tart lemon and Earl Grey notes.
Hazy DDH IPA dry hopped with Citra and experimental HBC-638, brewed with barley, wheat and oats.
Old-school American IPA dry hopped with Centennial: floral, juicy-fruit gum and a hint of pine, pleasantly bitter with an oily, resinous mouthfeel.
Part of the Gelato XTREME series: sour smoothie/pastry style beers with over 40% fruit, very thick and intensely sour and sweet.
Imperial stout brewed with Lua using Canadian maple syrup, cacao nibs from Beskid Chocolate and fluffy marshmallows; decadent and dessert-like.
Part of the Gelato XTREME series: sour smoothie/pastry style beers with over 40% fruit, very thick and intensely sour and sweet.
Part of the Gelato XTREME series: sour smoothie/pastry style beers with over 40% fruit, very thick and intensely sour and sweet.
Blend of long-boiled barley wine from Woodford double-oaked bourbon barrels and imperial stout from Jack Daniel's barrels, aged 14 months with cocoa nibs and figs.

Collab with Bad Seed for Great Doink Day 2026: a new-school West Coast DIPA with a very light malt body and mouthfeel and a solid bitterness at the end. Hopped with Cashmere, Columbus, Citra and Mosaic.
Double IPA brewed with Bru-1, Mosaic and Vic Secret hops for a fruity, punchy and citrussy aroma and flavour.

beers.name: Squish Time
beers.style: Lager w. pink grapefruit and earl grey

beers.name: Superundulation
beers.style: Imperial sour w. raspberry, rhubarb and blackcurrant

description.text: Souped-up version of Gamma's Undulation sour: higher ABV, more fruit and added vanilla.

beers.name: Tangaroa
beers.style: BA Flanders Red w. blueberries, blackberries and tayberries

beers.name: Crimson Veil
beers.style: BA Flanders Red w. Rooibos, rhubarb and Damson plums

beers.name: Honeyfang
beers.style: Mix ferm sour w. scottish honeyberries

description.text: Golden sour blended from two Brettanomyces-fermented batches, conditioned on Scottish honeyberries; citrus and stone-fruit aromatics, built to drink young or age.

beers.name: Iron Goddess
beers.style: Mix ferm sour w. strawberries and Oloong tea

description.text: Mixed-fermentation sour refermented on first-harvest 2026 Scottish strawberries, with a cold infusion of Nanling Mountain Milk Oolong tea; a collaboration with Black Kite of Hong Kong.
Pina colada-inspired double sour IPA with wheat, oat, milk sugar, pineapple and coconut, hopped with Citra and Nelson.
Sour IPA brewed with wheat, oat, basmati rice, milk sugar, Japanese plums, sea salt and lemongrass, hopped with Mosaic and Azacca.
Brunch-style sour IPA with wheat and peaches, hopped with Citra.
Organic Rauchbier in the Märzen style, brewed with pilsner, Munich and smoked malt. A dark lager with full malt sweetness and soft, rounded smoke.
Full-bodied, round Baltic porter with soft notes of dark chocolate, cocoa and a little dried fruit. Malt-led, sweet and harmonious with little bitterness.
Blend of four saison barrels from the same brew, each fermented with a guest brewery's yeast (Cantina Errante, La Montagnarde, Meta, Burning Sky).
Blend of barrel-aged wild ales with locally grown hand-picked cherries, dried fig leaves and Timut pepper.
Blend of barrel-aged saisons and mixed-fermentation beers (the 2023 edition used six barrels aged about 10 months on average).
Witbier-style wheat beer brewed with wild fennel seeds.

beers.name: Echidna
beers.style: Smoothie sour w. coconut, mango, kiwi, banana and pineapple

description.text: From Mortalis' Gemini line of fruited smoothie sours, a tangy base loaded with two or more fruits.
From Mortalis' Hydra line: a thick, juicy, tangy smoothie sour with at least three fruits, balancing sweetness and tartness.
Take on a classic German pils: Golden Promise malt, German lager yeast and German Callista hops. Crisp, clean and refreshing with bracing citrus notes.
Golden lager celebrating heritage barley, brewed with a blend of 10 barley varieties.
Very fruity pale ale with nectarine, passion fruit and orange notes, a touch of sponge cake and pine, and distinct bitterness.
Richly hopped double IPA with orange-blossom honey; ripe mango, orange and mandarin with honey sweetness and a mild bitter finish.
Fruity IPA named for the Hindi word for orange; notes of passion fruit, pineapple, grapefruit peel, pine and honey with distinct bitterness and slight sweetness.
Dark red-hued wild ale inspired by Flemish Oud Bruin traditions; one drinker likened its sourness to cold red wine in beer form.
Double NEIPA with a velvety body and tropical aromas of mango, grapefruit and a touch of coconut, from Krush, Citra, Sabro, Mosaic and Simcoe hops.
Hazy IPA with Citra and Mosaic: light melon, ripe sticky pineapple and fresh pear, with tropical and citrus notes.
Palindrome's first double IPA, hopped with Nelson Sauvin, Citra, Mosaic and Strata. Juicy and layered with citrus, guava, peach and passionfruit.
Triple hazy IPA: vibrant, juicy and complex, with tropical fruit, sticky citrus zest, sweet red berries, lollipop candy and a white grape character.
Hazy double IPA with a tropical fruit punch aroma, peach rings, white wine spritzer and candied melon, balanced by red grapefruit.
Hazy IPA that opens like dank berry soda, with candy-like tropical sweetness from Azacca against sharp citrus and white-wine notes from Nelson.
Gose with fresh horseradish and a touch of dill, giving a sharp, spicy kick over tart acidity and a classic salty finish.
Unfiltered Czech light lager with Saaz Shine and Harmonie hops: elegant bitterness, herbal-floral aroma, a hint of citrus and a dry finish.

beers.name: SOMMAR
beers.style: BA Sour w. elderflower and rhubarb

description.text: Fruity, very tart sour with notes of apple, rhubarb and elderflower; moderate bitterness, lighter body, little sweetness.
Very tart rhubarb lambic-style beer with barrel, rhubarb, apple cider vinegar, hay, citrus peel and light bread notes.

beers.name: ÄPPLE
beers.style: Spontaneous fermented Wild Ale w. Cox Orange apples

description.text: Tart, fruity wild ale made with Cox Orange apples, with notes of orange, apple cider vinegar, light bread, hay and almond paste.
Nuanced, tart blackberry beer with notes of barrel, dried apricot, blackberry, malt vinegar, nuts, hay and blood grapefruit.
Distinctly tart sour with notes of barrel, dried apricot, elderflower, straw, blood grapefruit, apple cider vinegar and herbs.
Coconut version of Root + Branch's American pale ale, with visible coconut flakes. Drinkers describe it as sweet, smooth, juicy and crushable with a strong coconut character.

beers.name: Christmas in July at a Fire Island Beach House

description.text: Hazy double IPA brewed with a mix of oats and wheat. Drinkers call it juicy.
West Coast style IPA hopped with Columbus, Citra, Comet, Mosaic and Simcoe.
Italian-style pilsner dry-hopped with Hallertau Tradition and Saphir. Clean and dry with delicate toasted bread and mild citrus notes.

beers.name: Kaffesnyd
beers.style: NE DIPA w. coffee from Sydhavnskaffe

description.text: Gluten-free West Coast IPA with a little Cara malt for an orange hue. Dry hopped with Galaxy, Simcoe and Centennial for citrus zest, ripe tropical fruit and a piney, resinous finish.
Barley wine infused on toasted coconut flakes and tonka beans, brewed for the brewery's 6th birthday.
Gluten-free hazy IPA brewed with wheat and oats for a soft body. Dry hopped with Galaxy, Idaho 7 and Citra Hyperboost for passionfruit, peach, citrus, lime and some pine.
Double IPA with plenty of wheat and oats for a soft body, heavily dry hopped with Simcoe, Simcoe Cryo and Enigma. Grapefruit, tropical fruit, red berries and pine, with a dank edge.

beers.name: Maple Syrup Barrel Aged Bokkenrijder
beers.style: BA Imperial Stout w. cocoa nips and vanilla

description.text: Low-strength pale ale on Maris Otter and rolled oats with batch-varying hops; soft, rounded body, gentle carbonation and restrained bitterness.
Stout based on an 1890s recipe: creamy head, dark chocolate and espresso bitterness with vanilla and dried fruit, rich smooth texture.
Flemish-style brown ale, rich and sour: brown bread, red fruit, a hint of strawberry, then balsamic and tannic notes with a sharp, spritzy acidity.
Light 8° Czech pale lager brewed in honour of Kladno's smelters and Bohumil Hrabal. Munich malt and carapils give body and Gaia hops add a spicy, earthy note; light, refreshing and very drinkable.
Exotic DDH double IPA hopped with Amarillo, Citra and Mosaic, with intense mango, pineapple and citrus aroma, a full juicy body and mild bitterness.
Barrel-aged smoothie sour made with Azvex, inspired by the Scottish dessert: juicy fruit, creamy lactose and heather honey, with vanilla, oak and whisky from Speyside barrels.
Fruited sour with blueberries, blackberries and raspberries plus edible glitter; fruit-forward, refreshing and tart.
Imperial pastry sour balancing crisp apple, sweet maple syrup and a dusting of pecan; sweet, nutty and delicately tart.

beers.name: Habengut
beers.style: Imperial Stout w. coconut, hazelnut, vanilla beans and cocoa nips

description.text: Imperial stout triple-mashed for a thick, oily body, aged three years in a 9-year-old Fary Lochan whisky barrel for dense, powerful barrel character.

beers.name: Dippedut
beers.style: Imperial Stout w. pecans, pistachio praliné, vanilla beans and coca nips
